content.title: Grindr names veteran executive John North as finance chief
content.summary: Dating app Grindr on Wednesday named John North as its finance chief, replacing Vanna Krantz. North stepped down as CEO of U.S. recreational vehicles retailer Lazydays Holdings last year. Krantz, in July, had said she would step down once a successor is named.

content.summary: Lazydays Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:GORV) shares are trading lower after the company released its fourth-quarter FY24 earnings results on Monday. The company reported a fourth-quarter sales decline of 19.2% year-on-year to $159.88 million from $198.03 million last year. Loss per share of $2.39 narrowed from a $7.59 loss last year. content.title: Lazydays Holdings’ Inaction on Stock Buybacks Raises Investor Concerns
content.summary: Lazydays Holdings, Inc. (GORV) has disclosed a new risk, in the Debt & Financing category. Lazydays Holdings, Inc. has not undertaken any repurchase of its common stock during the quarter ending September 30, 2024, despite having significant authorization from its Board of Directors. The company has an approximate dollar value of $63,370,543 remaining under its repurchase plans, indicating a potential lack of strategic focus on capital return to shareholders.
